chunks: Knowledge is belief which is acted upon. With it man acquires obedience during his life and a good name after his death. Knowledge is the ruler while wealth is ruled upon.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between knowledge and wealth according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This passage from the Letter of Kumayl underscores the Shia emphasis on 'ilm as the foundational criterion for spiritual and social hierarchy, where knowledge commands and wealth serves. It highlights the dual benefit of scholarly pursuit: securing divine pleasure (ta'ah) in this life and establishing a virtuous legacy (husn al-khutbah) in the next. This reflects the broader tradition where the scholar (alim) holds a status superior to the wealthy, as intellect guides action.
